summary: v56n public upgrades tested (both backend + frontend). Backend: 7/7 pytest passed. Frontend: 8/9 flows passed — one regression confirmed: homepage tender card body click still routes to /register (deep-link fix is overridden by a stale onCardClick listener in PmcLinkPatcher).

ui_bugs.issue: Clicking the body of article.pmc-tender on the public homepage navigates to /register instead of /notices/<ref>. The new deep-link block at line 1020 is correct, but a leftover document-level listener onCardClick (lines 1044-1055) still fires and navigates to /register, defeating the fix. The live-board rows work correctly; only tender cards fail.

action_items: In /app/frontend/src/components/PmcLinkPatcher.jsx around line 1044-1055, either remove the onCardClick listener entirely (now handled by the deep-link block in the main onClick) OR change its navigation target from '/register' to the deep-link path using extractNoticeRef(art). Current behaviour sends every public tender-card body click to /register, which is the exact regression the v56n deep-link upgrade was meant to fix.
critical_code_review_comments: Duplicate click handlers on article.pmc-tender (onClick capture at line 1020 AND onCardClick at 1044) — classic source of flaky routing. Consolidate into a single handler.
PmcLinkPatcher.jsx is 1085 lines (>700 threshold). Split into: deepLinks.js, publicNav.js, roleGuards.js for maintainability.
Public /api/v1/meta/public/contact correctly validates missing fields (422) and returns a tracked reference ENQ-YYYY-#####. Reference also appended to audit_log. Good.
verify-record endpoint returns full 64-char SHA-256 hashes and resolves by seq (digits/#NNNN) and target_id — all paths tested green.
test_credentials: None required — all tested endpoints/pages are public.
seed_data_creation: Created 2 TEST_ contact enquiries via POST /api/v1/meta/public/contact (ENQ-2026-00003 and ENQ-2026-00004). Harmless, append-only, cannot be deleted per ledger policy.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend verify-record and public contact are solid. On re-test, specifically re-run frontend tender-card click: navigate to '/' , query article.pmc-tender, call .click(), expect URL to contain '/notices/PMC-NOT-'. Also re-check Live board rows (passed), 'Closing this week' chip → status=closing, Awards KPI → status=awarded, and Trust /trust Verify flow (passed with ref '2840' showing 'Record intact' + hash chain details).
rca_of_the_issue: RCA: PmcLinkPatcher.jsx registers two document-level click delegators that both match article.pmc-tender. The newer deep-link path (lines 1020-1027) uses extractNoticeRef to navigate to /notices/<ref>, but a legacy onCardClick listener (lines 1044-1055) also attaches to document and unconditionally navigates to '/register' when not vendor-authed. Depending on listener order, the legacy one still runs after the main onClick returns (preventDefault doesn't stop sibling listeners). Fix: delete the onCardClick listener registration, or update its navigate() call to use extractNoticeRef(art) first and only fall back to /register when ref is missing. Reproduction: open https://pmc-forest-green.preview.emergentagent.com/ → scroll to 'Open for bids this week' → click any article.pmc-tender card body (not the 'View notice' link) → observes navigation to /register. Expected: /notices/PMC-NOT-2026-00xx.
